notes.title: New Track for Couch Co-Op Fest!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello drivers,[/h1]

This week, we're celebrating the joy of playing with friends by releasing a new track for Steam's Couch Co-Op Fest! Additionally, we have an amazing sale for all the drivers that have not joined the race yet! 

[h3]Enjoy 40% off for the entire week! [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/73a06706113066b39e7a7d6e11575b1501f6d693.png[/img]

Here are the details on the new track, as well as other changes in Patch 1.1.3!

[h2]Le Circuit des Ecuyers[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/777d2720b75d7c7d1f292e96c4762bd53c56ec25.png[/img]

Located in France close to the Paris region, the Circuit des Ecuyers is a relatively recent development and mainly offers test and advanced driving days. However, a few minor competitions have been held there.
The track, with 17 bends, is highly technical and varied.

You can play this new track and its 3 layouts starting today!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/f52594bbcd17385288ecf73c0d281a79f3c37b6c.png[/img]

[*] Expected time on "Qualification 2" in Feed Racing School has been fixed.
[*] Lola T91/50 team icons have been fixed.
[/list]

[b][i]See you soon drivers![/i][/b]
ZGS & MaxEnt Teams

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/930c2dca43d5bad3c7b6f2d8363287e859df2727.png[/img]

notes.title: Patch 1.1.1 - Steam Deck, Wheel Support & Crossplay
notes.content:
Hey drivers,

Here's our major update for November! We're bringing crossplay to Hot Lap Racing, and it starts right now!

If you didn't get the game yet, we're running a special discount for you this week ♥

[h3]Online[/h3]

[list]
[*] CROSS-PLATFORM: Nintendo Switch, Steam and Epic Games Store players can now play together online.
[*] When you can't find a quick game, you're now invited to create a lobby instead.
[*] Added a button to select your online region directly in Public / Private game modes.
[/list]

[h3]New Devices[/h3]
[*]  Full Steam Deck support! Verified button is ongoing, but should be there soon! 
[*] Added Wheel support and wheel adjustment options!

About wheel support, we have worked on a global basis to cover as many wheels as we could.
We have tried wheel support on a couple of modern wheels such as TRS 300 Trustmaster or Logitech G29. Don't hesitate to share your feedback and your wheel model in the Steam forum so we can help getting more wheels supported by the game!

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

[list]
[*] Slipstream: The slipstream phenomenon has been increased.
[*] Slipstream: A.I. should take better account of slipstream.
[*] Track exits should be better calculated, more precise and less penalizing.
[*] In local multiplayer, players can now play with the camera inside the car.
[*] “Manual” standing start now expects the player to shift into first gear (shifting into first gear will no longer be automatic).
[/list]

[h3]Bugfix[/h3]

[list]
[*] Main menu music should reactivate normally if player skips tutorial (on first game launch).
[*] Fix player 2+ options navigation in local multi if player 2+ was a keyboard.
[*] The LolaB02/00 should display its RPM/KMHs correctly in cockpit view.
[*] Various rebinding bugfixes.
[/list]

It's your time to race once more!
See you soon for another update...

Zero Games Studios & MaxEnt teams!

notes.title: Patch 1.1 is Now Live - 3 New Cars!
notes.content:
Hello drivers,

Get ready to try your driving skills with three new cars in today's Patch 1.1! In addition to three new cars, we've also added a new Overview system where you can get a better look inside and outside of the car. We've also made some bug fixes to provide you with the best experience in the motorsports universe that we can.

[h1]The New Cars[/h1]

[h2]RBM 4LM JTC[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/66643148f40876868b75fb759e10ba82375a9827.png[/img]

The 4LM in the Japanese GT Championship is a car with a strong overall performance, with a top speed higher than any of its rivals'. However, the choice of rear-wheel drive over all-wheel drive for other championship contenders makes it less efficient on winding circuits.

[h2]Stuotgarten 191S GT3[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/1f5f3fe1c9c2de6be6b6f8bd776a6bbcdb47e53c.png[/img]

The 191S has long been a regular in the GT3 field. In fact, it's one of the most common cars in these championships. Although on paper some of its rivals are faster, it remains a powerful, robust and well-balanced car, and above all one of the easiest to maintain and repair.

[h2]Duqueine D08[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/b11b05df430add759e6fdfd2c3c25abac1f0ea84.png[/img]

Duqueine Engineering's D08 prototype is eligible for a large number of championships. The car has won several constructors' and drivers' championships since its debut in 2020, and many teams have adopted it for its performance and reliability.

[h2]Full Patch Notes[/h2]

[list]
[*] 3 new cars available immediately in all solo game mode and in the Career championships:
     - RBM 4LM JTC
     - Stuotgarten 191S GT3
     - Duqueine D08
[*] The Feed Racing School tutorials in Career have been tweaked to make it more accessible and easier to complete.
[*] A new "Overview" feature allows you to get a better look inside/outside of the car in the car selection menu.
[*] Fixed the display issue on Electric race events in Career mode.
[*] Various bugfixes.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/4d08429d45f75ed7797facfa6c1bf34ad6160d40.png[/img]

Update Hot Lap Racing today and check out all the updated content!

Thank you very much,

ZGS & ME teams

notes.title: New car reveal: Brabham BT24!
notes.content:
[h1]Let's introduce you to the Brabham BT24![/h1]

[h2]Brabham BT24: [/h2]
[list]
[*]Number of victories: [b]3[/b]
[*]Number of races: [b]21[/b]
[*]Number of Podiums: [b]12[/b]
[*]Horsepower: [b]345[/b]
[/list]

Competing in Formula 1 between 1967 and 1969, the Brabham BT24 was an extraordinary car that took three Grand Prix victories in the hands of Dennis Hulme and its creator Jack Brabham. 
It's the elder racing licensed car from the game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/87e8d3ea67d6bcf915b465ff2e70d3b9a7e3bb01.gif[/img]

The two drivers finished first and second respectively in the 1967 world championship, which ensured that the BT24 became the car that enabled Brabham to become constructors' world champion at the same time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/85b1dddbb78b3490fc16ac0cc28756e76f4ecbfd.gif[/img]

[h2]Hot Lap Racing is releasing on July 16, 2024![/h2]

notes.title: To celebrate 24 hours of Le Mans we're revealing a new car!
notes.content:
[h1]24 hours of Le Mans happened this weekend![/h1]

24 Hours of Le Mans is an endurance-focused sports car race that's held in France every year. It's one of the most famous races in the world! 

[h2]Let's talk about the Peugeot 9X8![/h2]

The Peugeot 9X8 is the most surprising model in the Hypercar category of the world endurance championship. It is the only car without a rear spoiler, giving it an unusual silhouette. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/512b06beb9584a083d2fc8eb90cbc7103cc63a87.gif[/img]

In terms of aerodynamics, the front spoiler is adjustable and Peugeot has opted to create downforce at the rear with a very wide diffuser. The powertrains of the 9X8 is hybrid, with a twin-turbocharged V6 producing 680hp and two electric motors producing 272hp.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/528d453566aade28bfec1ce1bc400815027462d9.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Renault Laguna BTCC is pulling out of the garage!
notes.content:
[h1]Hot Lap Racing will welcome the Renault Laguna BTCC in the game! [/h1]

This thrilling amalgamation of cutting-edge automotive engineering and high-octane racing prowess started in the[b] late 90's. [/b]


[h2]Renault Laguna BTCC : [/h2]
[list]
[*][h3]Number of races:[/h3] 165
[*][h3]Number of victories:[/h3] 38
[*][h3]Number of Podiums:[/h3] 103
[*][h3]Horsepower:[/h3] 295
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/1e5cd2af7556bdea4c0f3086582e70f789db14e2.gif[/img]

[b]The Renault Laguna[/b] was one of the great driving forces during the golden age of the BTCC championship. It even helped Renault in its winning run, to clinch[b] 1997[/b] drivers' and constructors' titles in the series. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44597615/f8fc43215b9231f1c22d9bc99772565648aeadd3.gif[/img]

Developed in conjunction with and with help from the renowned Williams F1 team, the Laguna took part in 165 races, winning an impressive 38 victories and 103 podiums.
